purpose: Rule-local validation ownership for atomic rules whose normative value and provenance stay inherited while their proof-contributing evidence differs from the aggregate parent.

font.size.reduced.catalog-card.reason: The catalog card is supplied as an external PDF and included without restyling; the class controls inclusion, physical placement and pagination, not the PDF's internal typography.

font.size.reduced.footnote.reason: The layout gate measures the rendered 10 pt footnote sample for this exact atomic dimension.

font.size.reduced.pagination.reason: The layout gate measures rendered pagination glyphs at 10 pt for this exact atomic dimension.

toc.heading.alignment.reason: The frontmatter gate measures the Sumário heading against the text-area center.

toc.heading.case.reason: The frontmatter gate observes and asserts the uppercase Sumário heading.

toc.page-number.position.reason: The frontmatter gate measures TOC page-number alignment at the right text boundary.

toc.section-hierarchy.mirror.reason: The frontmatter gate compares TOC and body hierarchy styles for the controlled five-level fixture.

illustration.source.required.reason: The objects gate requires a rendered source marker and emits rule-specific bounded evidence.

illustration.source.external-citation.reason: The documentary-source gate asserts an external adapted source rendered with author-date citation tokens.

table.ibge.open-sides.reason: The object-geometry gate inspects final-PDF vector boundaries and asserts open table sides.

table.ibge.body-grid.reason: The object-geometry gate inspects final-PDF vectors and asserts absence of the body grid.

table.ibge.top-rule.reason: The object-geometry gate identifies the final-PDF top boundary rule.

table.ibge.header-rule.reason: The object-geometry gate identifies the final-PDF header separator rule.

table.ibge.bottom-rule.reason: The object-geometry gate identifies the final-PDF bottom boundary rule.
